title: Operation Chokepoint
tagline: Fight as a Punk or Fed in Operation Chokepoint. Players will need to cooperate or strategically sabotage in order to get the most points.
description: In Operation Chokepoint, a Farcaster Frame game, players are randomly assigned as Punks or Feds. Each team is fighting it out to win the most rounds. Every round players will have to decide whether they'll support their group or sabotage for extra personal points. If too many players sabotage then their team will automatically lose the round and forfeit their points. We envisioned that it would be pay to play, so players compete for a pot over a week of gameplay.
how_its_made: We used the Frog-Vercel template from Farcaster, it helped getting us exposed to the Farcaster ecosystem really quick. This was definitely a different developer experience. Before posting our frame we used the validator to make sure everything works well. In addition to that we posted on Warpcaster to demo our project.
